question: Who designed the new Indian rupee symbol?
solution:
The correct answer is __**D Uday Kumar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **D Uday Kumar** designed the new Indian rupee symbol.
 
• The symbol was officially adopted by the Indian government in **2010**.
 
• The design of the symbol is a blend of the Devanagari letter "र" and the Latin capital letter "R" without its vertical bar.
 
• This new symbol represents the Indian economy's strength and global recognition.
 
• D Uday Kumar is an Associate Professor in the Department of Design at the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Guwahati.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian rupee symbol was chosen through an open competition conducted by the Government of India.
 
• The adoption of the symbol is part of India's effort to establish its currency as a global brand.
 
• The Indian rupee symbol is now used on various financial and business documents, as well as on currency notes and coins.
 
• D Uday Kumar's design was selected from among five shortlisted symbols.
 
• The symbol has been incorporated into Unicode and major operating systems, enhancing its global usage and recognition.
